protocol.scope: Preloaded BGR image to CPU prediction: preprocessing, host-device transfers, model, and task postprocessing (class score/argmax or NMS/boxes). Excludes disk I/O and model loading.
protocol.sampling: All 270 fixed validation image IDs; 45 per class. Classification uses its supplied grayscale images, detection its supplied RGB images; these representations are not pixel-identical.
protocol.synchronization: CUDA synchronized before and after each sample
protocol.limitation: Task input sizes and output requirements differ; compare end-to-end application cost, not pure architecture speed or factory throughput.

models.scope: Memory BGR image to CPU class/score: color conversion, resize/normalization, host-device transfer, forward and softmax/argmax; excludes disk I/O and model loading.
